response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse_per_telescope FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_avg_pulse FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), above_overall AS (SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse_per_telescope, oa.overall_avg_pulse FROM telescope_averages ta CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE ta.avg_pulse_per_telescope > oa.overall_avg_pulse), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_per_telescope) as second_avg_pulse FROM above_overall), final_telescopes AS (SELECT ao.telescref, ao.avg_pulse_per_telescope, ao.overall_avg_pulse, sa.second_avg_pulse FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN second_average sa WHERE ao.avg_pulse_per_telescope > sa.second_avg_pulse) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_per_telescope) as mean_average_pulse_rate, AVG(avg_pulse_per_telescope - overall_avg_pulse) as avg_above_overall, AVG(avg_pulse_per_telescope - second_avg_pulse) as avg_above_second FROM final_telescopes
